messages:
oliver: Noticed a p99 spiral at ~02:14 that correlates with lots of tiny allocations. Looks like pinned staging saturation causing head-of-line stalls.

oliver: Brief root cause: small allocs get pinned to avoid faulting during inference, but under bursty load eviction falls behind and we end up queuing.

maria: Can we flip a quick knob? reduce pinned duration? :eyes: 

oliver: Two short fixes: 1) drop pinned-window 300ms -> 40ms (emergency), 2) route <2KB to ephemeral mmap fastpath that avoids cross-request pins.

raj: Ephemeral decreases pinning but will increase pagefaults and cold p99. Alternative: tiny_slab + per-tenant soft credits + global reclaim token. If tokens exhausted, fallback to ephemeral.

raj: Prototype config snippet:
```
tiny_slab.max_pages=512
tiny_slab.soft_credit_per_tenant=6
global_reclaim_burst=32
ephemeral_fallback=true
```

raj: This keeps hot microrequests fast while limiting noisy-tenant blast radius. Credits decay over time; enforce 2x burst cap.

maria: How do we detect noisy tenants quickly?

raj: Telemetry: per_tenant.soft_credit_used, tiny_slab.fallback_rate. If soft_credit_used spikes, auto-throttle tenant to ephemeral for short window.

oliver: Tradeoffs: more accounting complexity + extra telemetry vs fewer system-wide stalls. Also ephemeral path could spike pf-rate; need to measure.

sophia: Observability asks: tiny_slab.usage, tiny_slab.evictions, ephemeral.pagefaults_per_min, per_tenant.soft_credit_used, and a sampled stack trace on first N stalls/min. I can scaffold dashboards.

maria: Any driver-hacks? ask GPU vendor to change pin behavior?

oliver: Not reliable across fleet. We can expose runtime hints for certain instance types but mustn't depend on them.

ci-bot: CI flaky on branch "pin-surge-mitigation": tests/test_small_allocs.py::test_concurrent_load failed: AssertionError expected <=50ms got 210ms

raj: I'll reproduce locally and toggle soft credits + ephemeral to collect pf-rate/p99/eviction metrics.

oliver: Plan: implement tiny_slab + soft credits behind a feature flag (canary 5%). Add telemetry and a console emergency knob to cut pinned-window to 40ms.

maria: Action items:
- raj: prototype and perf matrix (pf-rate, p99, eviction) by EOD tomorrow
- oliver: add telemetry names and emergency knob in console
- sophia: add tracing sampler and dashboard skeleton

raj: ACK, will post numbers.

oliver: If metrics look promising we'll draft an RFC for allocator contract changes (per-tenant credits + reclaim hooks).

sophia: :thumbsup:
